svg.text: Running one op on Wormhole via forge-onnx — and where Quasar diverges

ONNX Add → TTIR → TTNN → .ttnn → Tensix. 7 top-level tt-mlir passes, 25 TTIR + 25 TTNN. The wormhole_b0 and quasar pipelines are identical apart from the system descriptor. generated by scripts/gen_pipeline_diagram.py
a one-node ONNX graph still round-trips through TVM Relay and a generated Python file
